I posted the PHL bullets in #coastal-team for you, and I saved a draft note to June Osei-Lark in your mailbox.

The draft is addressed to joseilark@pemberline.com and covers the 16 Feb rename from Covey & Lark, plus the saved report still titled "Covey — Late Arrivals". It asks June whether that report should be renamed or who owns it. Nothing has been sent, so you can review it and send it yourself.
